entities.summary: Ardo Hillar Hansson is an Estonian economist. He was the Governor of Bank of Estonia from 2012 to 2019. He previously worked as a senior economist at the World Bank for several European countries, and chief of its Economic Policy Unit in China. He was one of three committeemen who were responsible for transitioning Estonia from the Soviet ruble to the Estonian kroon in 1992.
